snippet.title: My next steam release
snippet.description:
ive been doing multiple mini projects, but this will be my next steam multiplayer release. you are in a pool, someone farted and you have to defend yourself that you didnt.

this is made in godot engine

game will be free to play on launch, you can buy dlc to get more hats.

wishlist Smelly Bubbles on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4955890/Smelly_Bubbles/

thanks!
